<module id="multi_booth_8bit">
    <description>Radix-4 Booth Multiplier</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="reset">Reset signal.</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplicand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplier.</input>
        <output id="p" width_description="[15:0]">Product.</output>
        <output id="rdy">Ready signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description></parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="ctr" width_description="[4:0]">Counter for iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="rdy" width_description="[0:0]">Ready signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p" width_description="[15:0]">Product register.</reg>
        <reg id="multiplier" width_description="[15:0]">Multiplier register.</reg>
        <reg id="multiplicand" width_description="[15:0]">Multiplicand register.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clk or posedge reset
        always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
            // Check if reset is active
            if (reset == 1'b1) begin
                // Initialize multiplier and multiplicand registers
                multiplier <= {{8{a[7]}}, a};
                multiplicand <= {{8{b[7]}}, b};
                // Set ready signal to 0
                rdy = 1'b0;
                // Reset product register
                p = 16'h0000;
                // Reset counter
                ctr = 5'd0;
            end else begin
                // Check if counter is less than 16
                if (ctr < 5'd16) begin
                    // Left shift multiplicand register by 1
                    multiplicand = multiplicand << 1;
                    
                    // Check if current bit of multiplier register is 1
                    if (multiplier[ctr] == 1'b1) begin
                        // Add multiplicand to product register
                        p = p + multiplicand;
                    end
                    
                    // Increment counter
                    ctr = ctr + 1;
                end else begin
                    // Set ready signal to 1
                    rdy = 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
